ValidationRule.description: If Type of the Case is any of the following mentioned in the Condition through error.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c != true, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', OR( ISPICKVAL(Type , 'Outage – WX'), ISPICKVAL(Type , 'TimeStar Termination'), ISPICKVAL(Type , 'WO Termination'), ISPICKVAL(Type , 'WO/WA Transition'), ISPICKVAL(Type , 'CASPSL'), ISPICKVAL(Type , 'New Jurisdiction')), ISNULL( NSP_Due_Date__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Due Date is required for this Case Type
